Maya (CEO): @here Quick heads-up — short all-hands this Friday 10:00am PT (45m). Please read and react. :calendar:
Maya (CEO): Agenda (high level):
- 10m: Exec snapshot + company health
- 15m: Product launch demo (live)
- 5m: Policy update: data retention + audit logs
- 10m: Roadmap highlights + Q&A (live & pre-submitted)
- 5m: Close + next steps
Maya (CEO): Slide deck + meeting doc: https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1redwood-demo (view/comment)
Maya (CEO): Drop Qs in this thread OR add to the Q&A form (prefer short 1-2 bullet asks): https://forms.gle/redwood-allhands-qa
Leila (Engineering Manager): Can we include a 3-slide rollout plan for the launch demo? I'll add an appendix slide.
Kendall (Head Eng): Heads up for APAC folks — recording and captions will be posted. If you need an async summary, react with :wave: and we'll surface a written TL;DR.
Ivy (People Ops): RSVP reminder: in-person seats limited. If you're coming to the office lunch, add your name here: tinyurl.com/rw-allhands-lunch
Jamal (VP Product): For the demo, we'll show the feature on Dedicated + Hosted fallback. I'll post the sample prompts in the deck so folks can reproduce.
Ops-bot: Calendar invite created and shared to the company. Reminder scheduled 1h before.
R&D-bot: Note: product demo will use model variant v2.3-q (perf profile updated). See internal model-catalog link.

-- meeting happened --

Ops-bot: Recording uploaded: https://meet.google.com/rec-redwood-3532108888 (transcript available)
Maya (CEO): Thanks everyone who joined live. Quick top-line takeaways: 
- Launch is a go for next Tues.
- Data retention policy: default retention reduced to 90 days for dev orgs; enterprise customers can opt for longer via contract.
- Dedicated capacity performance within SLA; some burst tuning tasks assigned to infra.
Maya (CEO): Action items (owners):
- Jamal: finalize rollout runbook (+ playbook for fallback) — due Thu COB
- Kendall: infra burst-tuning tickets + measurement plan — due Mon EOD
- Leila: post-deployment smoke test checklist + owners — due Wed
Jamal (VP Product): Got it — will drop the runbook link here when ready.
Kendall (Head Eng): I'll create the tuning tickets and tag the SRE oncall. Expect updates in eng-runtime channel.
Leila (Engineering Manager): I'll own smoke tests and coordinate with QA. Adding checklist to the deck now.
Ivy (People Ops): Recording + TL;DR will be added to the company wiki and weekly roundup. If you want your question anonymized in the digest, say so here.
Maya (CEO): Small FYI on policy: security & legal approved the retention change; you'll see an email with details tomorrow. If this affects a customer, flag it in the support channel and we'll coordinate comms.
Jamal (VP Product): Runbook draft: https://docs.google.com/document/d/redwood-runbook-draft — comments welcome.
Kendall (Head Eng): Tagging follow-up: #eng-runtime for the tuning plan.
Kendall (Head Eng): Marking my items as in-progress.
Ops-bot: Action items recorded to the company tracker: https://tasks.redwood.internal/board/ALLHANDS-3532108888
Maya (CEO): Thanks all. If you missed it, watch the recording and add reactions on the doc. We'll close the thread after 72h with a final action summary. :sparkles:
